correctness.rationale: A standalone exact checker reconstructs the 18-vertex 30-edge graph, exhausts all 108 nine-edge perfect matchings and 30,353 nonempty faces, validates 14,436 individual elementary-collapse pairs, and leaves the three-complex with face counts (30,270,694,487). A 29-edge spanning tree and 241 triangular relations eliminate the entire fundamental-group presentation. Exact integer unit Schur-complement pivots on the simplicial third boundary produce 453 unit Smith invariant factors and no residual entries, with boundary-square zero. Thus H_2=0 integrally and H_3=Z^34; Hurewicz and Whitehead yield a wedge of 34 three-spheres. The actual package verifier and certificates were executed and replayed; finite enumeration is exhaustive, not sampled.

originality.rationale: The claim treats perfect-matching extendibility on the longitudinally periodic three-row cylinder P_3 Cartesian C_6. The full motivating preprint treats P_3 Cartesian P_2n with no cyclic end-edge, while the two-row circular-ladder theorem cannot cover this three-row graph. An exact published calculation for the same graph concerns the strictly larger ordinary matching complex: it has 57,535 nonempty faces rather than 30,353 and homotopy 48 fifth-spheres rather than 34 third-spheres. Published C_3 Cartesian P_6 comparisons close a different row boundary. No result that implies this exact classification was identified in repeated semantic index and literature queries. Priority risk persists for inaccessible or unindexed equivalent work.
residual_risks: The index search cannot establish global publication priority, including work not indexed or using alternative topology terminology.

value.rationale: The canonical first even six-column periodic enlargement of the three-row square strip changes the already classified open-grid S^2 into a 34-fold wedge of S^3. This is a complete integral homotopy classification of a pure eight-dimensional complex, supplies a concrete nonshellability example, and resolves a genuine boundary-sensitive topological invariant that neither face counts nor the older open-strip formula determine. The claim has intrinsic mathematical motivation in periodic boundary effects, without pretending to establish an all-width formula.
